content.json:
# KiroFactory Dashboard

Real-time observability for the KiroFactory orchestrator and worker sessions.

---

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "kirofactory-orchestrator"
| where Log_s has "session-started" or Log_s has "session-stopped" or Log_s has "session-created"
| extend parsed = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend eventType = tostring(parsed.event)
| summarize
    Started = countif(eventType == "session-started"),
    Stopped = countif(eventType == "session-stopped")
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| extend ActiveDelta = Started - Stopped
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| extend RunningEstimate = row_cumsum(ActiveDelta)
content.title: Active Sessions Over Time

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "kirofactory-orchestrator"
| where Log_s has "session-started" or Log_s has "session-stopped" or Log_s has "session-error"
| extend parsed = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend eventType = tostring(parsed.event), sessionId = tostring(parsed.sessionId)
| summarize
    Running = dcountif(sessionId, eventType == "session-started"),
    Stopped = dcountif(sessionId, eventType == "session-stopped"),
    Errored = dcountif(sessionId, eventType == "session-error")
| project
    ['🟢 Running'] = Running,
    ['⏹️ Stopped'] = Stopped,
    ['🔴 Errored'] = Errored
content.title: Session Status (Current Period)

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "kirofactory-orchestrator" or ContainerGroupName_s contains "worker"
| where Log_s has "worker-spawned" or Log_s has "worker-started" or Log_s has "startWorkerJob"
| summarize SpawnCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Worker Spawns (per 5 min)

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "kirofactory-orchestrator"
| where Log_s has "session-started" or Log_s has "session-stopped" or Log_s has "session-error"
| extend parsed = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend eventType = tostring(parsed.event), sessionId = tostring(parsed.sessionId)
| summarize StartTime = minif(TimeGenerated, eventType == "session-started"), EndTime = maxif(TimeGenerated, eventType in ("session-stopped", "session-error")) by sessionId
| where isnotempty(StartTime) and isnotempty(EndTime)
| extend DurationMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', EndTime, StartTime)
| summarize AvgDuration = avg(DurationMinutes), MaxDuration = max(DurationMinutes), MinDuration = min(DurationMinutes), SessionCount = count() by bin(StartTime, 1h)
| project TimeGenerated = StartTime, ['Avg (min)'] = round(AvgDuration, 1), ['Max (min)'] = MaxDuration, ['Min (min)'] = MinDuration, Sessions = SessionCount
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Session Duration Statistics

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "kirofactory-orchestrator"
| where Log_s has "session-started" or Log_s has "session-stopped" or Log_s has "session-error"
| extend parsed = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend eventType = tostring(parsed.event), sessionId = tostring(parsed.sessionId)
| summarize StartTime = minif(TimeGenerated, eventType == "session-started"), EndTime = maxif(TimeGenerated, eventType in ("session-stopped", "session-error")) by sessionId
| where isnotempty(StartTime) and isnotempty(EndTime)
| extend DurationMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', EndTime, StartTime)
| summarize AvgDuration = avg(DurationMinutes) by bin(StartTime, 1h)
| project TimeGenerated = StartTime, AvgDurationMinutes = round(AvgDuration, 1)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Average Session Duration Over Time

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "kirofactory-orchestrator" or ContainerGroupName_s contains "worker"
| where Log_s has_any ("worker-exited", "worker crashed", "SIGKILL", "OOMKilled", "exit code")
    or (Log_s has "exitCode" and Log_s !has "exitCode\":0" and Log_s !has "exitCode: 0")
| summarize CrashCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Worker Crashes (per 5 min)

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "kirofactory-orchestrator"
| where Log_s has_any ("500", "502", "503", "\"status\":5", "Internal Server Error", "Service Unavailable")
    and Log_s has_any ("/api/", "HTTP")
| summarize ErrorCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: API Errors (5xx per 5 min)

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "kirofactory-orchestrator"
| where Log_s has "Database" and Log_s has_any ("unavailable", "reconnect", "failed", "timeout", "ECONNREFUSED")
| project TimeGenerated, Message = Log_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 20
content.title: Recent Database Connection Issues

content.query:
ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "kirofactory-orchestrator"
| where Reason_s has_any ("FailedHealthProbe", "Unhealthy", "BackOff", "ContainerCrashLoopBackOff")
    or (Log_s has "probe" and Log_s has "failed")
| summarize FailureCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Reason = Reason_s
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Health Probe Failures

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ContainerAppName_s == "kirofactory-orchestrator" or ContainerGroupName_s contains "worker"
| where Log_s has_any ("error", "ERROR", "warn", "WARN", "crash", "failed", "timeout")
| project TimeGenerated, Source = coalesce(ContainerAppName_s, ContainerGroupName_s), Log = Log_s
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Recent Errors & Warnings (last 50)
